commitMessage: DEV-17: Build persistent session state manager
objective: Create a deterministic persistent session-state system that records active development context, current phase, specification, plan, execution progress, validation state, repair history, and resumable workflow state across River Dev invocations.
acceptanceCriteria: The agent can create a deterministic session state from repository and development context.
Session state records the active branch, phase, specification, plan identity, current lifecycle step, status, timestamps, validation state, repair history, and resume metadata.
Session state persists across River Dev process invocations.
Session state can be loaded deterministically from repository-local storage.
Interrupted sessions can be recognized as resumable when their repository context still matches.
Sessions with mismatched branch or repository state are blocked from unsafe resume.
Completed sessions remain queryable without being treated as active work.
Existing River Dev run-state storage remains backward compatible or is migrated safely.
No session state is persisted outside the repository.
Focused tests, River Dev typechecking, and main-project typechecking pass.
